title: mcp-config — IS marketplace-tier v2 contract (projection-mirrored composition)
description: The v2 mcp-config authoring contract (the `.mcp.json` / plugin.json mcpServers per-server entry shape). PURE COMPOSITION — zero authored fields of its own. It is the allOf of three v2 layers: (1) the upstream base, REGENERATED from the captured projection per DR-062 (documented fields only, upstream requiredness incl. the per-transport conditional shapes, upstream wire forms `type` + `streamable-http`); (2) the three v2 universal folds by $ref to the v2 marketplace-tier foundation; (3) the v2 IS overlay (the relocated flat all-required narrowing + the carried IS tracking trio + the relocated `metadata` extension). v2 has ZERO $ref into the frozen v1 family (copy-then-regenerate); the v1 mcp-config composition stays the looser-where-it-matters PUBLISHED contract. The Zod validator AND this inline $comment effective-required manifest are GENERATED by scripts/codegen-authoring.ts from the base+overlay JSON Schemas — never hand-typed. Lifecycle SHIPPED-INTERNAL.
